description: Serie: Hochwassergefahrenkarten und Hochwasserschutz für Freiburg i. Br is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.freiburg.de. Die Geodatenserie verknüpft die unterstützenden Geodatensätze zu den Hochwassergefahrenkarten des Landes BW für das Stadtgebiet von Freiburg im Breisgau und Umgebung. Die eigentlichen HWGKs werden durch Dienste der LUBW bereitgestellt. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Series: Flood hazard maps and flood protection for Freiburg i. Br" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überflutung, HWGK, Überschwemmung, HWRK, Freiburg im Breisgau, Hochwassergefahrenkarte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-07-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
